_meta.tier: [measured] -- these are the compiler's own emitted layouts for THIS build. Not a hypothesis, not a reconstruction.
_meta.closure: priority classes + every class named in the DataWalk pass + transitive closure over base classes and member field types.
layout_notes: Every Order class inherits UnitOrder VIRTUALLY. The UnitOrder subobject therefore sits at the TAIL of the object (sizeof(class)-8), and offset 0 is the vbptr. Field offsets read out of loader/log_data code are frequently relative to that trailing UnitOrder subobject, i.e. displaced by -(sizeof(class)-8).
The X / XOut / XData triple is real: XData holds the POD sim state, XOut adds render/presentation members, X adds behaviour. Sim state is the XData layer.

Fields at identical offsets inside one class are anonymous-union members (e.g. UnitData +84 rare/air_alt/former_type; UnitData +134 hero/cara/doober/special/herd; BuildData +120 fort/dock/oil_well/farm).
GameAccess / GameAccessConst / MiscAccess are empty (1-byte) accessor bases; they cost no storage but do shift member offsets in some classes.
